title: \(d\)-degree Erdős–Ko–Rado：只剩 \(n=9,10\) 即可解决整个 \((k,d)=(4,3)\) 参数族
summary: A self-contained sharp proof establishes delta_3(F)<=1 for every intersecting 4-uniform family on n>=9; the original n=9,10 endpoints also have independently checked exact LRAT UNSAT certificates, and n=8 has an exact counterexample with delta_3=2.
evidence: arXiv:2407.14091v1 Theorem 1.1 and Conjecture 4.1 independently checked
No prior endpoint resolution or public certificate found by two recorded bounded novelty searches; Gan-Han-Im arXiv:2605.17945 does not cover n=9,10
Blind mathematical referee found zero fatal and zero major proof gaps
Canonical n=9 and n=10 CNFs have LRAT refutations accepted by a fresh build from pinned lrat-check.c source; eight adversarial traces are rejected fail closed
Independent literal verifier certifies the n=8 family: 35 edges and triple-degree histogram 42x2 + 14x4
All three citations were independently verified against official sources
Clean LaTeX/BibTeX build, manifest gate, font checks, and four-page visual PDF audit passed
